title: Cystic Aware
description: Adding a genetic disease to Minecraft because raising awareness is cool B)
body:
# Cystic Aware
This mod adds the genetic disease known as cystic fibrosis to Minecraft. The aim of this mod is to at least try to mimic the bare bones of cystic fibrosis so people without it can try to know what it feels like, but this mod also tries to make it a fun experience and challenge.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Ouy_d1F6ip4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Additions
- New Villager Type: the Surgeon
- Added Lungs and Damaged Lungs
- Added new gamerule to determine whether you have Cystic Fibrosis
- Added Lung Transplants to better your breathing
- Added Inhalers to better your breath twice over
- You can now be randomly get slowness, hunger, and nausea
- Added a new structure called the Nether Gazebo that has easy access to materials you may want
- You can cough


I have tried to make this mod as _accurate_ as possible. If there's anything I got wrong or if you have any suggestions, comment on one of my [YouTube](https://youtube.com/@realaxolotllord) videos or leave a post in my Community Tab!
